data.name: Tower Realm
data.detailed_description:
The Saga of Tower

Tower Name: The Saga of Tower
Content: Chapter 1
Total Floors: 65

Brought to you by a brand-new, amateur creator—The Saga of Tower now grandly opens its doors! You will step into the shoes of an amnesiac traveler, wandering through the world known as the Tower Realm...

Please show your support for us, Ciallo ~


Destined Melody

Tower Name: Destined Melody
Content:Full Version
Total Floors: 60

Have you ever heard of—or perhaps... still remember—the tale of the Magic Tower?

Two little slimes. One red slime. The sword on Floor 3, the shield on Floor 6. Years have passed, yet that "invincible" red bat still haunts my mind like a nightmare.

If your answer is "Yes," then come with me. Let us reclaim that original spark, don our armor once more, and relive this classic legend of a hero saving the princess...

Oh, and don't forget to say to the very first fairy you ever met: "Nice to meet you—I'm the hero!"


System Cultivating

Tower Name: System Cultivating
Content: Chapter 1
Total Floors: 80

Su Yu has transmigrated into a vast world of cultivation. With the power of the System, it's time to start cultivating!


About the Game

Tower Realm is a strategy RPG collection built around the classic “Magic Tower” gameplay formula. Here, you will challenge a variety of Magic Towers with distinct rules and styles: fixed stats, fixed maps, and fixed enemy setups, making every decision transparent and calculable. Resource allocation, route planning, and combat trade-offs will determine whether you can reach the end.

The towers included in this game are designed to be challenging, making it ideal for players who enjoy “thinking over grinding.” You can take the pure hardcore route and clear without any extra supplies, or use the Green Key to gain additional resources, lower the difficulty, and progress steadily.

We ensure that every tower has at least one clearable solution without using the Green Key.

After clearing a tower, you can earn points for Custom Mode. By spending points to adjust challenge conditions, modify enemy attributes, and alter stage experiences, you can explore strategy solutions that differ completely from the standard flow, continually gaining freshness and replay value.

After purchasing Tower Realm, you will unlock the standard content and launcher. Future tower content will be released continuously as DLC, all of which can be launched and experienced in a unified way within Tower Realm.

Core Features:

  • A collection of multiple Magic Towers, offering diverse strategic gameplay modes

  • Fixed maps and stat systems that emphasize deep, inferable strategy

  • Hardcore strategy at heart, with dynamic difficulty reduction so anyone can enjoy the game

  • DLC expansions with a large amount of continuously updated content

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200、AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 510 (Skylake)、AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: NVIDIA High Definition Audio
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K、AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050/AMD Radeon RX 460
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: NVIDIA High Definition Audio
